parameters.content:
## Discovery (Google Maps)
App → this webhook with `{ runId, callbackUrl, budgetUrl, plan[], perSearch }`.
One `compass/crawler-google-places` run per area (all terms together), results back to the app in batches of 100, then `kind: done`.
The app prefilters, deduplicates, enriches and scores.
